//: baselinefit detector rules. THIS FILE IS HAND-AUTHORED and contains no
//1: Baseline facts: no names, no statuses, no dates. Every key here is a
//2: web-features feature id, and tools/fetch-data.py refuses to build unless
//3: each one exists in the real web-features dataset. The dataset supplies
//4: name / description / spec / status / dates; this file supplies only the
//5: text patterns baselinefit greps for and the prose advice it prints.

aborting.removable_action: Delete the abortcontroller-polyfill import and its bundler alias; AbortController and AbortSignal are available natively.

anchor-positioning.risk_action: Anchor positioning is not Baseline in any browser set yet. Keep a JavaScript positioner, or gate the CSS behind @supports (anchor-name: --a).
anchor-positioning.removable_action: Do not remove the JavaScript positioner yet. This is a forward pointer only: when CSS anchor positioning reaches the level you target, most tether/flip logic collapses into anchor-name, position-anchor and position-try-fallbacks.

animations-css.removable_action: Drop the -webkit- animation declarations and the @-webkit-keyframes block; the unprefixed forms are enough.

appearance.removable_action: Delete the prefixed declarations and keep appearance: none.

aspect-ratio.removable_action: The @supports guard around aspect-ratio always passes now. Unwrap the block and delete the padding-top ratio hack it was protecting.

async-clipboard.risk_action: navigator.clipboard.write / read need a fallback at this target. document.execCommand('copy') still works as one, or feature-detect with 'clipboard' in navigator.

backdrop-filter.risk_action: backdrop-filter degrades to no blur rather than breaking, but the panel behind it may become unreadable. Set an opaque fallback background-color first, then override it inside @supports (backdrop-filter: blur(1px)).
backdrop-filter.removable_action: Safari has shipped the unprefixed property since 18, so -webkit-backdrop-filter is only needed for older Safari. Remove it once your target no longer includes those versions.

border-radius.removable_action: Delete the prefixed declarations; border-radius has been unprefixed everywhere for years.

box-shadow.removable_action: Delete the prefixed declarations; box-shadow has been unprefixed everywhere for years.

cascade-layers.risk_action: A browser that does not understand @layer drops the whole block, so the layered rules vanish rather than losing priority. Ship the styles unlayered at this target.

clip-path.removable_action: Delete -webkit-clip-path and keep the unprefixed declaration.

color-mix.risk_action: color-mix() in an unsupported browser makes the whole declaration invalid, so the property falls back to its inherited or initial value. Precede it with a static colour declaration.

container-queries.risk_action: A dropped @container block leaves the element at its default styling. Write the mobile-first rule outside the container query so the unstyled state is the usable one.
container-queries.removable_action: The @supports guard for container queries always passes now, and container-query-polyfill can leave the bundle.

content-visibility.risk_action: content-visibility: auto is a progressive enhancement, but contain-intrinsic-size must be set with it or scrollbars jump. Unsupported browsers simply render everything.

custom-properties.removable_action: Remove css-vars-ponyfill and its build step; custom properties resolve natively.

dialog.removable_action: Remove dialog-polyfill, its stylesheet and the registerDialog() calls; <dialog>, showModal() and ::backdrop are native.

fetch.removable_action: Remove the fetch polyfill import and any bundler alias for it.

field-sizing.risk_action: field-sizing: content is a recent addition. Keep the JavaScript autogrow or the rows/cols sizing you already have as the fallback.

filter.removable_action: Delete -webkit-filter and keep the unprefixed declaration. This is not the same property as backdrop-filter.

flexbox.removable_action: Delete the -webkit- flexbox declarations and the @supports (display: flex) guard. Note that display: -webkit-box and -webkit-box-orient are deliberately NOT reported: they are still load-bearing for -webkit-line-clamp.

flexbox-gap.removable_action: The @supports (gap: ...) guard always passes now. Unwrap it and delete the negative-margin gutter fallback underneath.

focus-visible.removable_action: Remove the focus-visible polyfill script, the .js-focus-visible / .focus-visible class plumbing and the @supports selector(:focus-visible) guard. Style :focus-visible directly.

grid.removable_action: The @supports (display: grid) guard always passes now. Unwrap the block and delete the float or inline-block fallback it was guarding.

has.risk_action: :has() fails the whole selector list in a browser that does not support it, so the rule never applies. Keep a class toggled from JavaScript at this target.
has.removable_action: The @supports selector(:has(...)) guard always passes now, and the css-has-pseudo build step can be dropped.

hyphens.removable_action: Delete -webkit-hyphens and -ms-hyphens; the unprefixed property is enough. Keep the lang attribute on the document, which hyphenation still needs.

intersection-observer.removable_action: Remove the intersection-observer polyfill import; the API is native.

lh.risk_action: The lh unit resolves to the element's line box height. Replace it with a calc() over your line-height variable at this target.

light-dark.risk_action: light-dark() makes the whole declaration invalid where it is unsupported. Declare the light value normally and override it inside a prefers-color-scheme media query.

masks.risk_action: An unsupported mask property leaves the element unmasked and fully visible, which is usually worse than not applying the effect. Gate it behind @supports.
masks.removable_action: Delete the -webkit-mask declarations and keep the unprefixed ones.

object-fit.removable_action: The @supports (object-fit: ...) guard always passes now, and object-fit-images / objectFitPolyfill can be deleted along with the background-image fallbacks they drove.

oklab.risk_action: oklch() and oklab() invalidate the declaration where they are unsupported. Put an sRGB hex or rgb() declaration immediately before as the fallback.

popover.risk_action: The popover attribute is inert where unsupported: the element stays in the flow and visible. Keep the polyfill or the JavaScript dialog at this target.
popover.removable_action: Remove @oddbird/popover-polyfill and its stylesheet; popover, popovertarget and showPopover() are native.

resize-observer.risk_action: Fall back to a window resize listener, or keep a polyfill, at this target.
resize-observer.removable_action: Remove resize-observer-polyfill / @juggle/resize-observer and use the global ResizeObserver.

rlh.risk_action: The rlh unit resolves against the root line box. Replace it with a calc() over a root custom property at this target.

scope.risk_action: An unsupported @scope block is dropped entirely, taking its rules with it. Scope with a class or a data attribute at this target.

scroll-behavior.removable_action: Remove smoothscroll-polyfill and its polyfill() call; scroll-behavior: smooth and the behavior: 'smooth' scroll options work natively.

scrollbar-gutter.risk_action: Without scrollbar-gutter the layout shifts when a scrollbar appears. That is the pre-existing behaviour, so this is a safe enhancement, but do not rely on the reserved space in measurements.

shared-workers.risk_action: SharedWorker is missing on some targets and has historically been absent from Chrome on Android. Feature-detect and fall back to a dedicated Worker per tab, or to BroadcastChannel for cross-tab messaging.

starting-style.risk_action: Without @starting-style the entry transition simply does not play; the end state still applies. Safe as an enhancement, but do not put required styles inside the block.

sticky-positioning.removable_action: Delete position: -webkit-sticky and the @supports (position: sticky) guard.

structured-clone.risk_action: Fall back to a manual deep clone at this target; JSON round-tripping is not equivalent for Map, Set, Date or typed arrays.
structured-clone.removable_action: Remove @ungap/structured-clone and call the global structuredClone().

subgrid.risk_action: grid-template-columns: subgrid is invalid where unsupported and the track list falls back to none, collapsing the nested grid. Declare an explicit track list first.

text-wrap-balance.risk_action: text-wrap: balance is a typographic nicety; where it is unsupported the text wraps normally. Safe as an enhancement.

text-wrap-pretty.risk_action: text-wrap: pretty is not Baseline in any browser set yet. Where it is unsupported the text wraps normally, so it is safe as an enhancement but cannot be relied on.

transforms2d.removable_action: Delete the prefixed transform declarations and keep the unprefixed ones.

transitions.removable_action: Delete the prefixed transition declarations and keep the unprefixed ones.

trusted-types.risk_action: Trusted Types enforcement is ignored where unsupported, so the Content-Security-Policy header is defence in depth rather than a guarantee. Keep sanitising on the server, and guard window.trustedTypes before calling createPolicy.

urlpattern.risk_action: Keep the router's own matcher, or the urlpattern-polyfill, at this target.
urlpattern.removable_action: Remove urlpattern-polyfill and use the global URLPattern.

user-select.risk_action: user-select is not Baseline: the unprefixed property alone is not enough. Keep -webkit-user-select alongside it. baselinefit therefore never reports that prefix as removable.

view-transitions.risk_action: Guard startViewTransition with a feature test and apply the DOM change directly when it is missing; view-transition-name on its own is inert.

viewport-unit-variants.risk_action: Precede the dynamic viewport unit with a vh or vw declaration so unsupported browsers keep a usable height.
